:::{#def-factorial}
#### Factorial

For a non-negative integer (@def-nonnegative-integers) $n$, the **factorial** of $n$ [@wikipedia_factorial], written $\factorial{n}$,
is the product $1 \cdot 2 \cdots n$ of the natural numbers from 1 to $n$.
For $n = 0$ that product has no factors, and $\factorial{0} = 1$.

:::
